name: How long does it take to install a sheer descent waterfall?
description: Installation time varies; it can add a few days to a week for new construction or take several days to two weeks for retrofitting into an existing structure.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a sheer descent waterfall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for installing a sheer descent waterfall depends on the project's scope. If it's part of a larger new pool or landscape construction, the integration can add a few days to a week to the overall project timeline for the water feature specific work. For retrofitting into an existing structure, it might take anywhere from a few days to two weeks, considering structural modifications, plumbing, and finish work.
